Chroma is a syntax highlighting library and command-line tool that takes source code and other structured text and converts it into syntax highlighted HTML, ANSI-coloured text, and other formats.

## Try it

Try out various languages and styles on the [Chroma Playground](https://swapoff.org/chroma/playground/).

## Command-line Interface

A command-line interface to Chroma is included.

Binaries are available to install from [the releases page](https://github.com/alecthomas/chroma/releases).

### Usage with `less`

The CLI can be used as a preprocessor to colorise output of `less(1)`,
see documentation for the `LESSOPEN` environment variable.

The `--fail` flag can be used to suppress output and return with exit status
1 to facilitate falling back to some other preprocessor in case chroma
does not resolve a specific lexer to use for the given file. For example:

```shell
export LESSOPEN='| p() { chroma --fail "$1" || cat "$1"; }; p "%s"'
```

Replace `cat` with your favourite fallback preprocessor.

When invoked as `.lessfilter`, the `--fail` flag is automatically turned
on under the hood for easy integration with [lesspipe shipping with
Debian and derivatives](https://manpages.debian.org/lesspipe#USER_DEFINED_FILTERS);
for that setup the `chroma` executable can be just symlinked to `~/.lessfilter`.

## Projects using Chroma

* [`moor`](https://github.com/walles/moor) is a full-blown pager that colorizes
  its input using Chroma
* [Hugo](https://gohugo.io/) is a static site generator that [uses Chroma for syntax
  highlighting code examples](https://gohugo.io/content-management/syntax-highlighting/)

Usage: executable [<files> ...] [flags]

Chroma is a general purpose syntax highlighting library and corresponding
command, for Go.

Arguments:
  [<files> ...]    Files to highlight.

Flags:
  -h, --help               Show context-sensitive help.
      --version            Show version.
      --list               List lexers, styles and formatters.
      --unbuffered         Do not buffer output.
      --trace              Trace lexer states as they are traversed.
      --check              Do not format, check for tokenisation errors instead.
      --filename=STRING    Filename to use for selecting a lexer when reading
                           from stdin.
      --fail               Exit silently with status 1 if no specific lexer was
                           found.

Select lexer and style:
  -l, --lexer="autodetect"    Lexer to use when formatting or path to an XML
                              file to load.
  -s, --style="swapoff"       Style to use for formatting or path to an XML file
                              to load.

Output format:

cands = [l.strip() for l in open('/tmp/candidates.txt') if l.strip()]
valid=[c for c in cands if c not in ("EOF","Whitespace","TextPunctuationBracket","CommentArray","GenericGeneric")]
specials = {"Background","PreWrapper","LineLink","LineTableTD","LineTable","LineHighlight","LineNumbersTable","LineNumbers","Line"}
res={}
for t in valid:
    open('/workspace/t.xml','w').write('<style name="t"><entry type="%s" style="#ff0000"/></style>\n'%t)
    r=subprocess.run(['./executable','-s','/workspace/t.xml','--html','--html-styles'],capture_output=True,input=b'')
    out=r.stdout.decode()
    kids=[]
    for line in out.splitlines():
        if not line.startswith('/* '): continue
        name=line[3:].split(' */')[0]
        if name in specials or name=='Error': continue
        kids.append(name)
    res[t]=kids
json.dump(res,open('/tmp/inherit.json','w'),indent=1)
for t in valid:
    print(t, '->', res[t])
PYEOF"}

bad=0
for c,i in m.items():
    j=d256[c]
    if j in by256 and by256[j]!=i: bad+=1
    by256[j]=i
print("non-functional 256->16:", bad)
items=sorted(by256.items())
print(len(items))
print(items[:60])
PYEOF

actions.command:
cd /workspace; python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json, math
d=json.load(open('/tmp/pal16.json'))
def hsv(c):
    r,g,b=[x/255.0 for x in c]
    mx=max(r,g,b); mn=min(r,g,b); dd=mx-mn
    v=mx
    s=0 if mx==0 else dd/mx
    if dd==0: h=0
    elif mx==r: h=((g-b)/dd)%6
    elif mx==g: h=(b-r)/dd+2
    else: h=(r-g)/dd+4
    return (h*60,s,v)
rows=[]
for i,c,ix in d:
    if c[0]==c[1]==c[2]: continue
    h,s,v=hsv(c)
    rows.append((h,ix,s,v,c))
rows.sort()
for h,ix,s,v,c in rows: print(f"h={h:6.1f} s={s:.2f} v={v:.2f} -> {ix:2d}  {c}")
PYEOF

    for j,v in enumerate(row):
        if prev and prev[1]==v: prev[0]=j
        else: prev=[[j],v]; runs.append(prev)
    print("%3d"%r, [(x[0][0]*4, x[1]) for x in runs])
PYEOF

    for wb in [x/2 for x in range(1,13)]:
        bad=0
        for c,exp in data:
            ds=[wr*(p[0]-c[0])**2+wg*(p[1]-c[1])**2+wb*(p[2]-c[2])**2 for p in base16]
            best_i=min(range(16), key=lambda j:(ds[j],j))

import json, re, subprocess
styles=json.load(open('/tmp/registry.json'))['styles']
css=json.load(open('/tmp/styles_css.json'))['styles']
ansi=json.load(open('/tmp/styleansi.json'))
allt=json.load(open('/tmp/alltypes.json'))
# validate the 6 missing types
missing=[t for t in allt if t in ("None","Text","TextSymbol","TextPunctuation","LiteralOther","LiteralStringAtom")]
print("missing from css:", missing)
def parse_bg_entry(name, props):
    d={'color':None,'bg':None,'bold':False,'italic':False,'underline':False}
    for p in [x.strip() for x in props.split(';') if x.strip()]:
        if p.startswith('color: '): d['color']=p[7:]
        elif p.startswith('background-color: '): d['bg']=p[18:]
        elif p=='font-weight: bold': d['bold']=True
        elif p=='font-style: italic': d['italic']=True
        elif p=='text-decoration: underline': d['underline']=True
    return d
# check the terminal16m value for the missing types equals the background merge
bad=[]
for s in styles:
    if s=='swapoff': continue
    bg=css[s]['Background']
    for t in missing:
        v=ansi[s].get(t,'')
        # expected: if bg colour set -> 38;2;R;G;B ; flags from bg
        exp=[]
        if bg['bold']: exp.append('1')
        if bg['underline']: exp.append('4')
        if bg['italic']: exp.append('3')
        if bg['color']:
            c=bg['color'][1:]
            exp.append('38;2;%d;%d;%d'%(int(c[0:2],16),int(c[2:4],16),int(c[4:6],16)))

            bad.append((s,t,v,';'.join(exp)))
print("missing-type mismatches:", len(bad), bad[:10])
# check whether Text is defined in any style: look at PreWrapper line
for s in styles[:0]: pass
PYEOF

// Get returns the entry for a token type, walking up the token type hierarchy.
func (s *Style) Get(t token.TokenType) StyleEntry {
	cur := t
	for {
		if e, ok := s.entries[cur]; ok {
			return e
		}
		if cur == token.Text {
			break
		}
		p := cur.SubCategory()
		if p == cur {
			break
		}
		cur = p
	}
	return StyleEntry{}
}
// Get returns a style from the registry.
func Get(name string) (*Style, bool) {
	s, ok := registry[name]
	return s, ok
}

func jsonEscape(s string) string {$
^Ivar b strings.Builder$

^I^I^Icase '\r':$

cd /workspace && python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json
# patch gen script to use styleansi2.json (list of seqs)
p='/workspace/gen_styles.py'
s=open(p).read()
s=s.replace("ansi=json.load(open('/tmp/styleansi.json'))","ansi=json.load(open('/tmp/styleansi2.json'))")
open(p,'w').write(s)
PYEOF
python3 - <<'PYEOF'
import json
styles=json.load(open('/tmp/registry.json'))['styles']
css=json.load(open('/tmp/styles_css.json'))['styles']
ansi=json.load(open('/tmp/styleansi2.json'))
allt=json.load(open('/tmp/alltypes.json'))
parents=json.load(open('/tmp/parents.json'))
pseudo=["Background","LineLink","LineTableTD","LineTable","LineHighlight","LineNumbersTable","LineNumbers","Line"]
special=['None','Text','TextSymbol','TextPunctuation','LiteralOther','LiteralStringAtom']
dumpTypes=pseudo+[t for t in allt if t not in special]
dumpSet=set(dumpTypes)
def Z(): return {'color':None,'bg':None,'bold':False,'italic':False,'underline':False}
def norm(e):
    e=dict(e)
    if e.get('color') in ('#None','inherit'): e['color']=None
    if e.get('bg')=='#None': e['bg']=None
    return e
def resolvedDump(s,t):
    e=css[s]
    if t in dumpSet: return norm(e.get(t,Z()))
    return None
def resolvedSpecial(s,t):
    bg=resolvedDump(s,'Background')
    out=Z()
    for seq in ansi[s].get(t,[]):
        if seq=='1': out['bold']=True
        elif seq=='4': out['underline']=True
        elif seq=='3': out['italic']=True
        elif seq.startswith('38;2;'):
            p=seq[5:].split(';'); out['color']='#%02x%02x%02x'%tuple(int(x) for x in p[:3])
        elif seq.startswith('48;2;'):
            p=seq[5:].split(';'); out['bg']='#%02x%02x%02x'%tuple(int(x) for x in p[:3])
    if out['color']==bg['color'] and not out['bg'] and not (out['bold'] or out['italic'] or out['underline']):
        out['color']=None
    for k in ('bold','italic','underline'):
        if bg[k]: out[k]=False
    return norm(out)
def resolved(s,t):
    if t=='PreWrapper': return None
    r=resolvedDump(s,t)
    if r is not None: return r
    return resolvedSpecial(s,t)
def parentResolved(s,t):
    p=parents.get(t)
    if p is None or p==t: return Z()
    return resolved(s,p)
data={}
for s in styles:
    if s=='swapoff':
        data[s]={}; continue
    ents={}
    for t in dumpTypes+special:
        if t in ('PreWrapper','LineLink'): continue
        r=resolved(s,t); p=parentResolved(s,t)
        if r==Z():
            if p!=Z(): ents[t]="NOINHERIT"
            continue
        need_noinherit = (r['color'] is None and p['color'] is not None) or (r['bg'] is None and p['bg'] is not None)
        if need_noinherit:
            fl=''
            if r['bold']: fl+='b'
            if r['italic']: fl+='i'
            if r['underline']: fl+='u'
            ents[t]="%s/%s/%s/noinherit"%(r['color'][1:] if r['color'] else '', r['bg'][1:] if r['bg'] else '', fl)
            continue
        fl=''
        if r['bold'] and not p['bold']: fl+='b'
        if (not r['bold']) and p['bold']: fl+='B'
        if r['italic'] and not p['italic']: fl+='i'
        if (not r['italic']) and p['italic']: fl+='I'
        if r['underline'] and not p['underline']: fl+='u'
        if (not r['underline']) and p['underline']: fl+='U'
        col=r['color'][1:] if (r['color'] and r['color']!=p['color']) else ''
        bgc=r['bg'][1:] if (r['bg'] and r['bg']!=p['bg']) else ''
        if col or bgc or fl:
            ents[t]="%s/%s/%s"%(col,bgc,fl)
    data[s]=ents
def merge(s,t):
    e=Z(); sd={'color':False,'bg':False,'bold':False,'italic':False,'underline':False}
    cur=t
    while True:
        if cur in data[s]:
            spec=data[s][cur]
            if spec=="NOINHERIT":
                return Z()
            parts=spec.split('/')
            noinherit = len(parts)>3 and parts[3]=='noinherit'
            fl=parts[2] if len(parts)>2 else ''
            if parts[0] and not sd['color']: e['color']='#'+parts[0]; sd['color']=True
            if parts[1] and not sd['bg']: e['bg']='#'+parts[1]; sd['bg']=True
            if 'b' in fl and not sd['bold']: e['bold']=True; sd['bold']=True
            elif 'B' in fl and not sd['bold']: e['bold']=False; sd['bold']=True
            if 'i' in fl and not sd['italic']: e['italic']=True; sd['italic']=True
            elif 'I' in fl and not sd['italic']: e['italic']=False; sd['italic']=True
            if 'u' in fl and not sd['underline']: e['underline']=True; sd['underline']=True
            elif 'U' in fl and not sd['underline']: e['underline']=False; sd['underline']=True
            if noinherit: return norm(e)
        p=parents.get(cur)
        if p is None or p==cur or cur=='Text': break
        cur=p
    return norm(e)
bad=[]
for s in styles:
    if s=='swapoff': continue
    for t in dumpTypes+special:
        if t in ('PreWrapper','LineLink'): continue
        exp=resolved(s,t); got=merge(s,t)
        if exp!=got: bad.append((s,t,exp,got))
print("mismatches:",len(bad), bad[:6])
json.dump(data, open('/tmp/styleown.json','w'), indent=1)
